jobs.title: Client Engineer
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities
Own the technical design, development, testing, release, and ongoing maintenance of mobile game client modules, ensuring reliable, high-quality delivery of requirements.
Independently implement client systems for core gameplay, UI interactions, and character presentation, working with game designers, artists, and technical artists to refine the player experience.
Design and maintain a clear, extensible client codebase that supports version updates, in-game events, and long-term live operations.
Work with server engineers to define APIs, data synchronization, and error handling, and integrate networking features, remote configuration, and analytics reporting.
Analyze and optimize CPU and GPU performance, memory usage, loading times, and network performance on mobile devices; resolve crashes, stuttering, and device compatibility issues.
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and incident reviews to improve code quality, test coverage, and delivery efficiency.
Collaborate with product managers, game designers, QA, and other cross-functional teams to break down technical tasks, identify risks, and drive issues through to resolution.

Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, with at least 3 years of game client development experience.
Proficiency in C# or C++, with project development experience using Unity, Unreal, or a comparable real-time game engine.
Experience with a released game or a complete project, with the ability to independently own client features from development and integration testing through to release and maintenance.
Familiarity with common client architectures, data structures, and software design approaches, with the ability to write stable, maintainable, performance-conscious production code.
Experience in mobile debugging and performance profiling, with an understanding of how device differences, memory, loading, frame rate, and network conditions affect games.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to conduct code reviews, share knowledge, and work effectively with game design, server engineering, QA, and other teams.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience launching mobile games or supporting long-term live operations, with familiarity with event updates, hot updates, asset package splitting, or remote configuration.
Experience building gameplay frameworks, UI frameworks, asset loading systems, network synchronization systems, or performance diagnostic tools.
Practical experience with automated testing, continuous integration, crash monitoring, or AI-assisted development tools.

Why Join Us
You will help build core mobile game experiences and the client engineering foundation, working closely with cross-functional teams to continuously improve game quality, iteration efficiency, and the player experience.

jobs.title: Server Engineer
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities
Own the design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation and maintenance of game backend services and core modules, ensuring features are delivered on schedule.
Design and implement game business logic, service APIs, and internal tools to support systems such as player data, game progression, items, quests, and events.
Design database schemas, caching, and message processing workflows according to business requirements, with a focus on data consistency, API performance, and service reliability.
Collaborate with the client team to define API protocols, data formats, error handling, and version compatibility approaches, ensuring reliable integration of client features.
Analyze production logs, metrics, and incidents to resolve performance bottlenecks and service issues; contribute to capacity assessments, release readiness, and incident reviews.
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and the development of engineering standards to improve code quality, testing, and automation.
Collaborate with product managers, game designers, QA, operations engineers, and other engineering teams to break down requirements, identify risks, and drive issues to resolution.

Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, with at least 3 years of backend development experience.
Proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, C++, Python, or C#, with experience developing and maintaining production services.
Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, databases, computer networks, and operating systems, with familiarity with common server-side design approaches.
Familiarity with at least one relational database and SQL, and an understanding of common components such as caching, message queues, and inter-service communication.
Experience troubleshooting production issues, optimizing performance, and improving service stability, with the ability to use logs, metrics, and debugging tools to identify problems.
Strong communication and cross-team collaboration skills, with the ability to independently deliver modules, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience developing and maintaining game servers, online games, or internet services that handle high levels of concurrent traffic.
Familiarity with Linux, cloud platforms, containerized deployment, continuous integration, or service monitoring and alerting systems.
Practical experience with distributed services, cache and message queue optimization, automated testing, or AI-assisted development.

Why Join Us
You will help develop and continuously optimize core game services, working with client and product teams to create stable, scalable gaming experiences and directly influence the quality of production systems.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Java/Node.js & Azure) (1 Year Contract)
jobs.description:
About the Role We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join a digital platform team supporting Facilities Management and Smart District operations.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, deploying, and maintaining modern web applications within an enterprise platform ecosystem. The role involves hands-on full stack development, system integration, Microsoft Azure, and DevOps, working closely with product managers, designers, technical leads, and business stakeholders.

The ideal candidate is a strong full stack engineer with experience building scalable enterprise applications, REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native solutions.

Key Responsibilities Full Stack Development

Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain modern web applications and services.
Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and React or Angular.
Build scalable backend applications and microservices using Java and/or TypeScript (Node.js).
Design, develop, and maintain REST APIs for application functionality and system integration.
Ensure applications are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise engineering standards.

System Integration & Data Services

Develop and maintain integrations between the digital platform and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging, and data services.
Implement event-driven integrations using technologies such as RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or equivalent platforms.
Support data exchange, synchronisation, and workflow integration across multiple applications.
Work with shared platform services including authentication, notifications, workflow, scheduling, and common APIs.
Troubleshoot integration issues and ensure reliable communication between systems.

Cloud Engineering & DevOps

Deploy and maintain cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Build and support containerised workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
Work with Azure services including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), API Management (APIM), Application Gateway, and Azure Key Vault.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting automated build, testing, deployment, and release processes.
Manage source code and development workflows using GitLab.

Security & Reliability

Apply secure software development practices and enterprise security standards.
Support TLS/certificate management, authentication, identity and access management, and secrets management.
Monitor application performance, availability, and operational health.
Perform troubleshooting and root cause analysis and implement improvements to application reliability.

Product & Delivery

Collaborate with product managers, service designers, technical leads, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and user needs.
Translate business requirements into practical and scalable technical solutions.
Participate in solution design, prototyping, technical reviews, Agile ceremonies, and release planning.
Support application migration, modernisation, and digital transformation initiatives.
Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate AI-enabled capabilities into applications where required.

Requirements Strong experience in full stack software development.
Proficiency in frontend technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and React or Angular.
Backend development experience using Java and/or TypeScript (Node.js).
Strong experience developing REST APIs and microservices.
Experience integrating enterprise applications through APIs and messaging technologies.
Knowledge of event-driven architecture and technologies such as RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Kafka.
Experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native application development.
Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience implementing or supporting CI/CD pipelines and GitLab-based development workflows.
Understanding of secure development practices, identity and access management, TLS/certificate management, and secrets management.
Familiarity with databases and data integration concepts.
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Good to Have Experience working within large enterprise or government environments.
Experience with workflow, case management, facilities management, or operational business applications.
Experience with application migration, modernisation, or digital transformation projects.
Exposure to service design, user research, or product-led development.
Experience integrating AI-powered capabilities into enterprise applications.
